sources.title: Resolved 93.3% → 68.8% for grandmaster. The reason the 14.6GB Occamy-1. ...
sources.snippet: I tested `IsValorum/Occamy-1.-APEX-I-MiniPlus-V2-GGUF`. It is 14.63GB in a single file, 3.38 bits-per-weight. It is a MoE based on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and the model card states it uses 'non-linear IQ codebooks manually designed for 256 fine-grained micro-experts.' In short, it claims to have crammed a 35B class model into the 14GB range.
